metadata.notes: First checkpoint of the proposed Sevii + birds program. The preconditions are checked before the Fly; Fly's Sevii page is not used (One Island may not be on it yet).

preconditions.why: a post-Elite Four save; the island guards and HMs assume it

preconditions.read_by: Trainer Card front (its star; a new reader)
preconditions.why: Celio's Ruby request and the Rainbow Pass come after the Hall of Fame

the first Sevii trip (Part 14) is done: the Vermilion sailor sails only then (pret VermilionCity_EventScript_FerrySailor: VAR_MAP_SCENE_ONE_ISLAND_POKEMON_CENTER_1F >= 1). Without it the program refuses and names the Part 14 drafts

preconditions.read_by: Pokedex menu or Trainer Card (a new reader)
preconditions.why: Celio asks for the Ruby only with it (IsNationalPokedexEnabled); Oak gives it in Pallet Town after One Island with 60 caught

preconditions.fact: party knows: fly, surf, strength, rock-smash, cut
preconditions.why: Fly to Vermilion, Cinnabar and Route 10; Surf for Water Path, Route 20 and the Power Plant; Strength and Rock Smash for Ruby Path and the birds' caves; Cut for the Dotted Hole's door

preconditions.fact: bag: escape-rope >= 5, ultra-ball >= 30, super-repel >= 10, full-restore >= 5, revive >= 5
preconditions.why: five caves, three birds; Supplies can provide all but the Full Restores' mart choice

checkpoint.title: Fly to Vermilion; the Seagallop to One Island
